en: The postcard features a black-and-white photograph of Indian wrestlers, known as 'pehlwans', engaged in traditional wrestling matches outdoors. The scene is set in front of a large colonial-era building with stone arches. Many men, some in loincloths and some in robes, observe the match. The setting and attire indicate a historical period, and the photo has a sepia or early photographic print feel.
